p: Bethcar Street is the pedestrianised main shopping street in Ebbw Vale, so Sun Valley is right in the middle of town. It's a town with a proud industrial history, built around the steelworks, and it was the constituency of Aneurin Bevan, the founder of the NHS.

Down the valley, the old steelworks site has been reborn as The Works, with the General Offices housing Gwent Archives, and a little inclined lift links the town centre with the area below when it is running. The railway runs from Ebbw Vale Town down the valley to Cardiff, and Festival Park, on the site of the 1992 Garden Festival, is close by too.
